document_model.logical_identity: Original native document or explicit saved link
document_model.edition_identity: Original content bytes plus received edition label
document_model.replacement: A corrected source creates a new edition and a visible comparison; the earlier complete file stays in the handover.

extract: Repeated sections and their native keys
Choice values and original selected flags
form_receiving.projection: Save the actual control/field map alongside the immutable form; canonical data maps to those actual controls.
form_receiving.publication: Generate any customer output from the selected original template and complete field/record mapping.

public_case.coverage_rule: Older indexed observations are field-level history. The current original source supplies the selected current published values.

restricted: Native credentials and personal account bindings
